provenance.paper_title: VISOR: Visual Evidence Space for Robust GUI and Visual Agent Reasoning

evidence.paraphrase: A dynamic trajectory window preserves recent visual observations for action evaluation.
The Evidence Space organizes task-relevant observations and intents for grounded correction.
During operation, VISOR applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to recent visual trajectory window; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, VISOR applies episodic or hierarchical summarization to recent visual trajectory window; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
A sliding trajectory window bounds retained visual history. For VISOR, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of recent visual trajectory window.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (recent visual trajectory window) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, episodic or hierarchical summarization, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
